2608.10916.title: FaithformBench: Benchmarking Faithfulness of Mathematical Chain-of-Thought Autoformalisation
2608.10916.paper_summary: Autoformalisation (AF) systems map natural language reasoning steps into formal statements in a proof assistant such as Lean. We consider how to assess the faithfulness of these systems. Existing approaches require expensive human-annotated ground truth, or rely on LLM judges or embedding models, which come with limited guarantees of accuracy. In addition, these methods typically only consider inputs that are known to be correct, and therefore do not assess whether the AF translates incorrect inputs faithfully. To address these limitations, we propose a new benchmark for AF faithfulness that is cheap to apply, sound under weak assumptions, and assesses both positive and negative examples. Our method is based on automatically generating perturbed reasoning steps that are designed to be invalid, and then measuring validity preservation on unperturbed steps and invalidity preservation on perturbed steps. We apply our method to eight AF systems across four mathematical datasets, and observe pervasive sycophancy: many AFs "silently correct" invalid inputs into provable statements. The most validity-preserving fine-tuned AFs are also the most sycophantic, suggesting a tension between validity and invalidity preservation in current AF systems.
2608.10916.paper_summary_zh: 自動形式化（AF）系統將自然語言推理步驟映射為證明助手（例如 Lean）中的正式陳述。<lb/>我們考慮如何評估這些系統的忠實性。<lb/>現有的方法需要昂貴的人類標註真實數據，或依賴大型語言模型（LLM）評審或嵌入模型，這些模型在準確性方面的保證有限。<lb/>此外，這些方法通常僅考慮已知正確的輸入，因此不評估 AF 是否忠實地轉換了不正確的輸入。<lb/>為了應對這些限制，我們提出了一個新的 AF 忠實性基準，該基準應用成本低、在弱假設下是健全的，並評估正面和負面範例。<lb/>我們的方法基於自動生成設計為無效的擾動推理步驟，然後測量未擾動步驟上的有效性保留和擾動步驟上的無效性保留。<lb/>我們將我們的方法應用於四個數學數據集中的八個 AF 系統，並觀察到普遍的阿諛奉承：許多 AF “默默地修正”無效輸入為可證明的陳述。<lb/>最能保留有效性的微調 AF 也是最阿諛奉承的，這表明當前 AF 系統在有效性和無效性保留之間存在緊張關係。
